==Glossary==

==References==
[1] [https://jira.atlnz.lc/browse/MRS-1071 MRS-1071] - MRS detailing the requirements<br>

=Overview=
==Introduction==

The purpose of this TFS is to describe the work that will be done to satisfy MRS-1071.

==Key Concepts==
When a user logs in to the device using the default login account 'manager', the device will check if the default account's password is the same as the factory default, if it is the same, the system will warn the user that the default password ('friend') for the default login account should be changed. 

==Architecture==
No architectural changes are required.

=Operational Specifications=
==Feature functionality that will be implemented==
{{Auto Spec|2616.1|The system will check at every login using the default account 'manager' if the factory default password 'friend' is set, if it is, the system will warn the user that the default password should be changed.}}

Example:
 awplus login: manager
 Password: 
 AlliedWare Plus (TM) 0.0.0 09/26/21 21:23:17 
 % Default password needs to be changed.
 awplus>
